replicated_originals.reference: Szabó-Bódi, Kasza & Szakos (2018) Assessment of household food waste in Hungary

A.reason: Ref [24]; the abstract and body describe the study as a replication of the first Hungarian household food waste measurement (2016 data, same FUSIONS diary methodology), and Table 5 compares 2019 results with [24].

B.reason: Sotiropoulos et al. (food waste dehydration) does not appear in the paper's text or reference list.

notes: New sample of 165 households measured in 2019 with the same FUSIONS methodology as the 2016 study; reports a 4% decrease. This is a descriptive measurement replication rather than a test of an effect.
